description: This file defines classes and functions related to performance metrics logging, including metrics for plugin activation, suspension, and page load events, as well as a Metric class for internal metric data handling.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: A class for handling internal metric data, providing methods to access the data and its length.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuput
classes.description: Implements performance metrics logging for plugin state events, such as activation, deactivation, suspension, and resumption.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuputBrowser
classes.description: Implements performance metrics logging for browser-related events, including page load, suspension, and URL changes.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables metrics logging by associating a plugin service and callsign, querying for memory interface.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables metrics logging and releases associated resources.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Logs plugin activation event and memory RSS.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Logs plugin deactivation event with uptime.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Logs plugin resumed event and memory RSS.

methods.name: Suspended
methods.description: Logs plugin suspended event and memory RSS.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Logs page load completion with success status, total success, total failure, and memory RSS.

methods.name: URLChange
methods.description: Placeholder for URL change event handling.

methods.name: VisibilityChange
methods.description: Placeholder for visibility change event handling.
